figurative_meaning_en: Auspicious or inauspicious times of the day
example_sentences_in_bangla: দিনক্ষণ দেখে বাড়ি থেকে বের হওয়া উচিত।
আজকের দিনক্ষণ অনুসারে এই কাজটি শুভ।
example_sentences_in_english: One should check the day and hour before leaving home.
According to today's auspicious times, this task is favorable.
history: Rooted in Hindu astrological practices of muhurta (auspicious timings) followed in Bengali culture.
note: Often used in contexts involving traditional rituals or important decisions.
